<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Best Stand Mixer – Complete Guide to the Best Stand Mixers of 2025 | Menu Moments</title>
<meta name="description" content="Finding the best stand mixer can completely transform your baking experience. We review the best stand mixers of 2025 including KitchenAid, Cuisinart, Hamilton Beach, Breville and more.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ============================================================
   ROOT VARIABLES
============================================================ */
:root {
  --primary:       #1f7a73;
  --primary-dark:  #16635d;
  --cta:           #f25c3c;
  --cta-dark:      #d44e31;
  --bg:            #f4efe9;
  --card:          #ffffff;
  --text:          #333333;
  --text-muted:    #666666;
  --border:        #e5e5e5;
  --green:         #2a9d6e;
  --star:          #f5a200;
  --shadow-sm:     0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
  --shadow:        0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.09);
  --shadow-lg:     0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.13);
  --r-card:        12px;
  --r-btn:         8px;
  --serif:         'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
  --sans:          'DM Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif;
}
/* ============================================================
   RESET & BASE
============================================================ */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; font-size: 16px; }
body { font-family: var(--sans); color: var(--text); background: var(--bg); line-height: 1.7; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
a { color: var(--primary); text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; }
a:hover { color: var(--primary-dark); }
ul { list-style: none; }
/* ============================================================
   TYPOGRAPHY
============================================================ */
h1 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(26px, 4.5vw, 44px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--text); }
h2 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(22px, 3.5vw, 32px); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--text); }
h3 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(18px, 2.5vw, 24px); font-weight: 600; color: var(--primary); line-height: 1.35; }
h4 { font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--text-muted); }
p { margin-bottom: 1em; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; }
p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
/* ============================================================
   LAYOUT
============================================================ */
.container { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 20px; }
.sec { padding: 72px 0; }
.sec-sm { padding: 48px 0; }
/* ============================================================
   BUTTONS
============================================================ */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  background: var(--cta); color: #fff;
  font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600;
  padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: var(--r-btn);
  border: none; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
  transition: background .2s, transform .15s, box-shadow .2s;
  white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1;
}
.btn:hover { background: var(--cta-dark); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(242,92,60,.32); }
.btn-lg { font-size: 16px; padding: 17px 32px; }
.btn-full { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
.btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--primary); border: 2px solid var(--primary); }
.btn-outline:hover { background: var(--primary); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(31,122,115,.28); }
.btn-white { background: #fff; color: var(--primary); font-weight: 700; }
.btn-white:hover { background: #f0f0f0; color: var(--primary); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }
.btn::after { content: "→"; font-size: 15px; }
.btn-outline::after, .btn-white::after { content: none; }
.btn-sm { font-size: 13px; padding: 10px 18px; }
.btn-sm::after { font-size: 13px; }
/* ============================================================
   BADGES
============================================================ */
.badge {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--primary); color: #fff;
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .07em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.badge-cta  { background: var(--cta); }
.badge-gold { background: #9a7200; }
.badge-gray { background: #636363; }
.badge-teal { background: var(--primary); }
/* ============================================================
   RATING
============================================================ */
.rating-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 8px;
}
.rating-score { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); }
.rating-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 500; }
.stars { color: var(--star); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
/* ============================================================
   HEADER
============================================================ */
.site-header {
  background: var(--card);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 200;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.header-inner {
  display: flex; align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 64px; gap: 16px;
}
.logo { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.logo em { font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-muted); }
.header-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; }
.header-nav a { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted); }
.header-nav a:hover { color: var(--primary); }
.btn-header { font-size: 13px; padding: 8px 18px; }
.btn-header::after { display: none; }
/* ============================================================
   HERO
============================================================ */
.hero {
  background: var(--bg);
  padding: 68px 0 56px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0;
  width: 55%; height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(31,122,115,.07) 0%, transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 0 0 0 80px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 56px; align-items: center; }
.hero-eyebrow { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .12em; margin-bottom: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.hero-eyebrow span { height: 1px; width: 32px; background: var(--primary); display: inline-block; }
.hero h1 { margin-bottom: 20px; }
.hero-intro { font-size: 17px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 28px; }
.hero-pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 32px; }
.pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted);
  background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 50px;
}
.hero-img-wrap { position: relative; }
.hero-img-wrap img { width: 100%; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); object-fit: cover; max-height: 440px; }
.hero-float {
  position: absolute; bottom: 20px; left: 20px; right: 20px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.hero-float-text { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }
.hero-float-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px; }
/* ============================================================
   QUICK VERDICT BOX
============================================================ */
.verdict-wrap { padding: 0 0 64px; }
.verdict-box {
  background: var(--card);
  border: 2px solid var(--primary);
  border-radius: var(--r-card);
  padding: 36px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr auto;
  gap: 36px;
  align-items: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  position: relative;
}
.verdict-box::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0;
  width: 5px; height: 100%;
  background: var(--primary);
  border-radius: var(--r-card) 0 0 var(--r-card);
}
.verdict-badge { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 20px; }
.verdict-img {
  width: 200px; height: 170px;
  object-fit: contain;
  background: var(--bg);
  border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px;
}
.verdict-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.verdict-name { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.verdict-body { font-size: 15px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.verdict-cta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 200px; }
.verdict-note { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); text-align: center; line-height: 1.5; }
/* ============================================================
   COMPARISON TABLE
============================================================ */
.table-section { background: var(--card); padding: 64px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.sec-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 40px; }
.sec-header h2 { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.sec-header p { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 17px; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; }
.sec-label { display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .12em; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.tbl-wrap { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; border-radius: var(--r-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; min-width: 680px; }
thead { background: var(--primary); position: sticky; top: 64px; z-index: 10; }
thead th { padding: 15px 18px; color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-align: left; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .07em; white-space: nowrap; }
thead th:last-child { text-align: center; }
tbody tr { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); transition: background .15s; }
tbody tr:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #fafaf9; }
tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(31,122,115,.04); }
td { padding: 16px 18px; vertical-align: middle; font-size: 14px; }
.td-img img { width: 68px; height: 52px; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg); padding: 4px; }
.td-name strong { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.td-cat { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); }
.td-price { font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); font-size: 15px; white-space: nowrap; }
.td-cta { text-align: center; }
/* ============================================================
   TRUST SIGNALS
============================================================ */
.trust-section { padding: 64px 0; }
.trust-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 20px; }
.trust-card {
  background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: 28px 22px;
  text-align: center; transition: box-shadow .2s;
}
.trust-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.trust-icon { font-size: 30px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.trust-card h4 { font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--text); }
.trust-card p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); margin: 0; line-height: 1.55; }
/* ============================================================
   TABLE OF CONTENTS
============================================================ */
.toc-wrap { padding: 0 0 64px; }
.toc-card {
  background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: 30px 36px;
  max-width: 750px; margin: 0 auto;
}
.toc-heading { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.toc-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2px 32px; counter-reset: toc; }
.toc-list li { counter-increment: toc; }
.toc-list a {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 8px 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted);
  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: color .2s, border-color .2s;
}
.toc-list a::before { content: counter(toc, decimal-leading-zero); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); min-width: 22px; }
.toc-list a:hover { color: var(--primary); border-bottom-color: rgba(31,122,115,.3); }
/* ============================================================
   PRODUCT REVIEWS SECTION
============================================================ */
.products-sec { padding: 72px 0; }
.product-card {
  background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-card); box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  margin-bottom: 48px; overflow: hidden;
  position: relative; transition: box-shadow .2s;
}
.product-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
.product-card-badge { position: absolute; top: 20px; left: 20px; z-index: 5; }
.product-card-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 280px 1fr; }
.product-img-col {
  background: var(--bg);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 40px 28px 28px; gap: 20px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.product-img-col img { width: 200px; height: 190px; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 10px; }
.product-info-col { padding: 32px 32px 28px; }
.p-num { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.p-name { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.p-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.p-overview { font-size: 15px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.75; padding-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); margin-bottom: 20px; }
.feat-title, .pros-title, .cons-title {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .1em; margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.feat-title { color: var(--primary); }
.pros-title { color: var(--green); }
.cons-title { color: #999; }
.feat-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.feat-list li, .pros-list li, .cons-list li {
  font-size: 14px; padding: 4px 0;
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; line-height: 1.5;
}
.feat-list li::before { content: "•"; color: var(--primary); font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0; }
.pros-list li::before { content: "✓"; color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 13px; }
.cons-list li::before { content: "✕"; color: #bbb; font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 1px; }
.pc-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.pros-box { background: rgba(42,157,110,.06); border: 1px solid rgba(42,157,110,.2); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; }
.cons-box { background: rgba(170,170,170,.06); border: 1px solid rgba(170,170,170,.22); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; }
.p-verdict { background: rgba(31,122,115,.07); border-left: 3px solid var(--primary); border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.p-verdict strong { font-weight: 600; }
.p-bestfor { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 20px; }
.p-bestfor strong { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }
.p-cta-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.p-amz-note { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); }
/* ============================================================
   BUYING GUIDE
============================================================ */
.guide-sec { background: var(--card); padding: 72px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.guide-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 28px; margin-top: 40px; }
.guide-card {
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: 28px;
  transition: box-shadow .2s;
}
.guide-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.guide-icon { font-size: 30px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.guide-card h3 { font-size: 18px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.guide-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.7; margin: 0; }
.guide-card ul { margin-top: 10px; }
.guide-card ul li { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 3px 0; display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.guide-card ul li::before { content: "•"; color: var(--primary); font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0; }
/* ============================================================
   COMPARISON SECTION (KA vs Ankarsrum vs Bosch)
============================================================ */
.compare-brands { padding: 72px 0; }
.brand-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 24px; margin-top: 36px; }
.brand-card {
  background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: 28px 24px;
  transition: box-shadow .2s;
}
.brand-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.brand-icon { font-size: 28px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.brand-card h3 { font-size: 18px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.brand-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.7; margin: 0; }
/* ============================================================
   HOW WE TESTED
============================================================ */
.tested-sec { background: var(--primary); padding: 64px 0; }
.tested-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 56px; align-items: start; }
.tested-sec h2 { color: #fff; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.tested-sec p { color: rgba(255,255,255,.82); font-size: 15px; }
.test-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-top: 16px; }
.test-item {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 18px;
  font-size: 14px; color: #fff; font-weight: 500;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
}
/* ============================================================
   MISTAKES SECTION
============================================================ */
.mistakes-sec { padding: 72px 0; }
.mistakes-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 24px; margin-top: 36px; }
.mistake-card {
  background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: 28px 24px;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--cta);
}
.mistake-icon { font-size: 28px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.mistake-card h3 { font-size: 17px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.mistake-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); margin: 0; line-height: 1.65; }
/* ============================================================
   WHO IS IT FOR
============================================================ */
.who-sec { background: var(--card); padding: 72px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.who-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 56px; align-items: center; }
.who-list { margin-top: 20px; }
.who-list li {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px;
  padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 15px;
}
.who-list li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.who-list li::before { content: "✓"; color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }
.who-cta-box {
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: 32px;
  text-align: center;
}
.who-cta-box p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 20px; }
/* ============================================================
   FAQ
============================================================ */
.faq-sec { padding: 72px 0; }
.faq-list { max-width: 780px; margin: 40px auto 0; }
.faq-item {
  background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; overflow: hidden;
}
.faq-q {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 20px 26px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; gap: 16px;
}
.faq-q:hover { background: rgba(31,122,115,.04); }
.faq-q-text { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); line-height: 1.4; }
.faq-toggle {
  width: 30px; height: 30px;
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 18px; color: var(--primary);
  transition: transform .3s;
}
.faq-item.open .faq-toggle { transform: rotate(45deg); }
.faq-ans { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height .35s ease; }
.faq-ans-inner { padding: 0 26px 22px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.75; }
/* ============================================================
   CONCLUSION
============================================================ */
.conclusion-sec { background: var(--card); padding: 72px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.conclusion-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 24px; margin-top: 40px; }
.con-card {
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: 28px 24px;
  text-align: center; transition: box-shadow .2s;
}
.con-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.con-card .badge { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.con-card img { width: 90px; height: 80px; object-fit: contain; margin: 0 auto 14px; background: var(--card); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px; }
.con-card h3 { font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.con-card p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 18px; line-height: 1.55; }
/* ============================================================
   FINAL CTA

<section id="buying-guide">
      Buyer's Guide
      <h2>Buying Guide – Choosing the Best Stand Mixer</h2>
      <p>Buying a stand mixer is an investment. Because stand mixers are expensive, choosing the right one matters. Some people buy a mixer primarily for cookie dough, while others need one capable of kneading dense bread doughs.</p>
    <h3 style="font-size:20px; margin-bottom:0; color:var(--text);">Features to Consider in a Stand Mixer</h3>
        ⚡
        <h3>Motor Power</h3>
        <p>A powerful motor is essential if you plan to make bread dough or pizza dough regularly.</p>
        🥣
        <h3>Bowl Size</h3>
        <p>Stand mixers come with bowls ranging from 3 quarts to 7 quarts. Larger bowls are ideal for batch baking.</p>
        🔧
        <h3>Attachments</h3>
        <p>Popular stand mixer attachments include:</p>
        <ul style="background:none; border:none; padding:8px 0 0; box-shadow:none;">
          <li>Dough hook</li>
          <li>Pasta roller</li>
          <li>Dough roller</li>
          <li>Meat grinder</li>
        </ul>
        <p style="margin-top:10px;">These attachments expand what your mixer can do.</p>
        🔄
        <h3>Tilt-Head vs Bowl-Lift</h3>
        <p><strong>Tilt-Head Stand Mixer:</strong> A tilt-head stand mixer allows the head of the mixer to tilt back for easy access to the bowl. These models are common among KitchenAid Artisan Series mixers.</p>
        <p style="margin-top:10px;"><strong>Bowl-Lift Stand Mixer:</strong> A bowl-lift stand mixer raises the bowl toward the mixing attachment. These are usually more powerful and common in professional kitchens. Examples include the KitchenAid Professional 600 or KitchenAid Pro 600.</p>
